item.tib: gsas mkhar spyi spungs dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las tshogs mchod tshogs gnyis gter gyi 'byung gnas
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las tshogs mchod 'bul thabs tshogs gnyis gter gyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i gzhung don kun la 'jug pa'i cha lags (lag) zur du phyung ba 'di ni lnga brgya thugs kyi ston pa bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i thugs bskyed kyi mthu las zab mo'i brda don ma 'gags par shar bzhin smon rgyal sems dpa'i ming 'dzin bdag gis bstan 'gror lhag bsam rnam dag pas (pa'i) sgo nas yig ris su bkod pas tshogs gnyis gter la spyod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
